about: K137: the project constants tools/kernel-subjects.py and tools/kernel-receipt.py read; K151: tools/next.py reads subject.row, subject.default_products and ranker through the same loader. K179: tools/evidence-store.py reads evidence.branch and evidence.worktree, names only. A missing or malformed file is refused (exit 2), never defaulted. Every key is required and no other key is allowed. Paths are repository-relative with forward slashes; patterns are Python regular expressions.

contract_defaults.bar: the CI bar workflows (product-bar and tools-bar, required tier) dispatched at the exact candidate SHA and at the landing merge, running on the runner CI_RUNS_ON resolves to; each run is the bar of record for its SHA
contract_defaults.passes: 3 identical green passes at one SHA; passed, failed, skipped and excluded counted separately
contract_defaults.env: the bar workflow's runs-on as resolved at the run: repository variable CI_RUNS_ON, at this writing the self-hosted ultra-magnus runner (Runner name {runner}), else windows-latest; its Python; TEMP and TMP as that runner sets them; CLOUDVORE_DATA_ROOT unset
contract_defaults.harness-limits: the bar workflow's job timeout and tools/run-tools-bar.py's per-suite timeouts, as committed at the candidate SHA
contract_defaults.seats: 2-3 non-author read-only review seats, each with a different attack question (operating-contract.md, Model routing)
contract_defaults.review-scope: the packet's diff against master at the candidate SHA, and every reader of what it changes
contract_defaults.rounds: not capped by count; a finding blocks only with a reproduction at the candidate SHA (operating-contract-swarm-rules.md section 2)
contract_defaults.planted-edits: every new pin is shown red by a planted break and mutants are executed before review (operating-contract-swarm-rules.md section 1, items 3 and 5)
contract_defaults.charter: no independent key dispatched (pending-cross-family); a key's charter, execution or static review, is declared here before dispatch
